config.gommemode.title: Gommemode
config.gommemode.option.enabled.tooltip: When disabled, the keybind does nothing and a running Gommemode is stopped.
config.gommemode.option.toggleKey.toolti: The key that toggles Gommemode. Same as the setting in Controls.
config.gommemode.option.toggleCooldownMs: Minimum time between two toggles, in milliseconds.
What happens when the Gomme hymn finishes while Gommemode is active.
With Play Song off there is no song end, so Gommemode stays on until you toggle it off.
config.gommemode.option.loopIntervalMs.t:
With "Loop Song": minimum time between two starts of the song, in milliseconds.
Keeps a song that cannot play (e.g. no audio device) from restarting all the time.
config.gommemode.option.messageDisplay.t: Where to show a message when Gommemode is turned on or off.
config.gommemode.option.soundEnabled.too: Play the Gomme hymn when Gommemode is activated.
config.gommemode.option.volumePercent.to:
Song volume, on top of the volume of the chosen sound category.
Changing it restarts a playing song from the beginning.
config.gommemode.option.pitchPercent.too:
Song pitch and speed. 100 % is the original.
Changing it restarts a playing song from the beginning.
config.gommemode.option.soundSource.tool:
Which volume slider in the Music & Sounds settings controls the song.
Changing it restarts a playing song from the beginning.
On: the song plays from the entity and gets quieter with distance.
Off: the song plays at the same volume everywhere.
Changing it restarts a playing song from the beginning.
config.gommemode.option.stopMusic.toolti:
Stop the Minecraft music while the song plays.
It returns after the usual pause once the song is over.
config.gommemode.option.spawnLocation.to:
Where the entity appears when Gommemode is activated.
Applies the next time Gommemode is activated.
config.gommemode.option.spawnDistance.to:
Maximum distance in blocks for crosshair placement. If nothing is in range, the entity spawns this far ahead.
Applies the next time Gommemode is activated.
Let crosshair placement stop at water and lava surfaces.
Applies the next time Gommemode is activated.
config.gommemode.option.particlesEnabled:
Show a particle sphere around the entity when it spawns.
Applies the next time Gommemode is activated.
config.gommemode.option.particleType.too:
Particle id, e.g. minecraft:firework, minecraft:heart, minecraft:flame.
Only particles without extra parameters are supported.
Applies the next time Gommemode is activated.
config.gommemode.option.particleRadius.t:
Radius of the particle sphere in blocks.
Applies the next time Gommemode is activated.
config.gommemode.option.particleStepSize:
Angle between particles in radians. Smaller values give a denser sphere.
Applies the next time Gommemode is activated.
config.gommemode.option.mainHandItem.too: Item id the entity holds in its main hand, e.g. minecraft:diamond_sword. Leave empty for nothing.
config.gommemode.option.offHandItem.tool: Item id the entity holds in its off hand, e.g. minecraft:shield. Leave empty for nothing.
config.gommemode.option.mainArm.tooltip: Which arm holds the main hand item.
config.gommemode.option.mainArmPose.tool: How the entity holds its main hand item.
config.gommemode.option.offArmPose.toolt:
How the entity holds its off hand item.
Without an off hand item, "Item" lets the arm hang down.
config.gommemode.option.lookAtPlayer.too: Make the entity turn to face you every tick.
config.gommemode.option.lookTarget.toolt: Which part of you the entity looks at.
config.gommemode.option.scale.tooltip: Size of the entity. 1.0 is player size.
config.gommemode.option.shadowRadius.too: Radius of the shadow below the entity. 0 disables it.
config.gommemode.option.showNameTag.tool: Show a name tag above the entity.
config.gommemode.option.nameTagText.tool: Text of the name tag. Leave empty for "GommeHD".
config.gommemode.option.glowing.tooltip: Draw a glowing outline around the entity, visible through walls.
config.gommemode.error.airItem: Leave the field empty to hold nothing
config.gommemode.error.complexParticle: Particle needs extra parameters and is not supported: %s
